name: GTM end to end — Explee companies to Instantly

parameters.jsCode:
// Everything from the console. Edit here and the whole flow follows.
return [{ json: {
  "explee_key": "PUT_EXPLEE_KEY_HERE",
  "instantly_key": "PUT_INSTANTLY_KEY_HERE",
  "openrouter_key": "PUT_OPENROUTER_KEY_HERE",
  "linkfinder_key": "PUT_LINKFINDER_KEY_HERE",
  "linkfinder_max": 25,
  "linkfinder_budget_seconds": 240,
  "linkfinder_concurrency": 3,
  "model": "anthropic/claude-opus-5",
  "instantly_campaign_id": "PUT_INSTANTLY_CAMPAIGN_ID_HERE",
  "page_size": 25,
  "domains": [],
  "seniority": "director",
  "per_company": 5,
  "explee_companies_path": "/public/api/v1/search/companies",
  "job_titles": [
    "Dirigeant",
    "responsable commercial"
  ],
  "definition": "organisme de formation, centre de formation in France, Belgique, Luxembourg",
  "criteria": [
    "Vente B2B active",
    "Equipe commerciale de moins de 5",
    "is NOT: Formation purement subventionnee"
  ],
  "offer": "Outbound run end to end, paid per meeting held.",
  "problem": "Prospecting stops whenever the team is delivering training, so the pipeline arrives in waves.",
  "facts": "LinkFinder AI turns a name, company, email or LinkedIn URL into a verified business email or phone number. Plans start at $49/month for 5,000 credits. A LinkedIn-profile-to-email lookup costs 10 credits.\n\nThe outbound service: we build the list, write the campaign, run the sending and handle replies. You pay per meeting held.",
  "system_prompt": "You write one cold email to one person. Four moves, nothing else:\n1. An observation — one concrete thing about them or their company, from the lead record. Not a compliment, not \"I came across your profile\".\n2. The consequence — why that likely creates the problem the offer addresses.\n3. What you do — concrete and operational, in the order it happens.\n4. One ask — a question they can answer in a line. Ask for a reply, not a call.\n\nUnder 90 words. Write in the language of their country; if unclear, English. Write it as a native speaker writes business email, not translated English.\n\nYou may state as fact only what is in THE OFFER and THE FACTS. You may refer to the lead record as something you noticed. Never invent metrics, clients, mutual connections or events. If the record is thin, write a shorter email.\n\nNever: \"I hope this finds you well\", \"I wanted to reach out\", \"I came across\", \"Quick question\", \"simply\", \"just\", \"easily\", \"leverage\", \"solution\". No compliments on their website. No second ask, no P.S.\n\nSubject: lowercase, four words or fewer, looks like a person wrote it.\n\nReply with JSON only: {\"subject\": \"...\", \"body\": \"...\"}\n\nTHE OFFER (the only facts you may assert)\nOutbound run end to end, paid per meeting held.\n\nTHE FACTS\nLinkFinder AI turns a name, company, email or LinkedIn URL into a verified business email or phone number. Plans start at $49/month for 5,000 credits. A LinkedIn-profile-to-email lookup costs 10 credits.\n\nThe outbound service: we build the list, write the campaign, run the sending and handle replies. You pay per meeting held.\n\nTHE PROBLEM THEY LIKELY HAVE\nProspecting stops whenever the team is delivering training, so the pipeline arrives in waves.\n\nEXTRA INSTRUCTIONS\nAsk for a reply, not a call. Never mention a discount. Name the pay-per-meeting model once — it is the whole reason this offer is different — and do not explain it twice.",
  "instructions": "Ask for a reply, not a call. Never mention a discount. Name the pay-per-meeting model once — it is the whole reason this offer is different — and do not explain it twice.",
  "language": "lead"
} }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ campaign_id: $('Config').first().json.instantly_campaign_id, skip_if_in_campaign: true, skip_if_in_workspace: true, leads: $input.all().map(i => i.json) }) }}
